root_cause.text: The loop condition in dlm_match_regions() uses '<=' instead of '<' when iterating through the qr_regions array, causing an out-of-bounds read past the valid range of the array indexed by qr->qr_numregions.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes line 1005 from `for (j = 0; j <= qr->qr_numregions; ++j)` to `for (j = 0; j < qr->qr_numregions; ++j)`. The CVE description explicitly states "The local-vs-remote region comparison loop uses '<=' instead of '<', causing it to read one entry past the valid range of qr_regions" and notes that "The other loops in the same function correctly use '<'", indicating this was an inconsistent and incorrect boundary condition that allowed array index j to reach qr->qr_numregions (one past the last valid index).

    ocfs2/dlm: Add message DLM_QUERY_REGION
    
    Adds new dlm message DLM_QUERY_REGION that sends the names of all active
    heartbeat regions. This message is only sent in the global heartbeat
    mode. If the regions in the joining node do not fully match the ones in
    the active nodes, the join domain request is rejected.
    
    Signed-off-by: Sunil
bic_trace_step.reason: The vulnerable construct is present in the dlm_match_regions() function at line 951 (in the inner loop comparing local regions with remote): 'for (j = 0; j <= qr->qr_numregions; ++j)'. This uses '<=' instead of '<', causing the loop to iterate one extra time beyond the valid array bounds. The qr->qr_regions array is indexed from 0 to qr->qr_numregions-1, so the condition should be 'j < qr->qr_numregions'. When j equals qr->qr_numregions, the memcmp at line 953 reads past the valid region data. The outer loop at line 948 correctly uses 'i < qr->qr_numregions', and the second comparison loop at line 963 also correctly uses 'j < localnr', but the first inner loop has the off-by-one error. This is a bug-introducing commit because the vulnerable code is newly added and contains the incorrect loop condition.
